summary.timing_scope: CPU, PyTorch4 threads, OpenCV20 threads; JPEG decode/RGB conversion + blue localization + grayscale crop + V28 forward. Excludes model loading, Image.open header access, drawing, export and GUI. Serial batch of the101 original1920x1080 photos; not a camera or FPGA throughput claim.
summary.scope: Internal original-photo regression.42 training-split originals used for development; remaining originals checked after initial locator config fixed. Existing crop boxes include context and are not precise object ground-truth boxes, so no IoU/mAP or precise coordinate error claimed.4 originally ambiguous defect labels excluded only from defect-classification metrics, retained for localization.
